mode: Research published by your assistant; continuous automation is not connected
scope: First screening pass for entry-level business, operations and analyst work; Houston prioritized as a starting assumption, with wider U.S. sources checked. Full-time roles after May 2027 prioritized. Locations and start dates still need your preferences.
summary: Seven listings or recruiting routes checked, plus EY policy guidance. One possible lead needs verification; four listings were ruled out and two are closed. No verified application-ready matches in this pass. No applications submitted.

records.title: QA Analyst / Business Analyst — Entry Level
records.sponsorship: Sponsorship mentioned; H-1B type not confirmed
records.finding: The staffing listing accepts business graduates and mentions sponsorship for selected candidates. Posting age, current vacancy, location, terms and a May 2027 start are not established.
records.fit: Business degree, organization, communication and problem-solving align. Formal QA and requirements-analysis experience is not demonstrated in the résumé.
records.next: Confirm employer identity, active opening, compensation, any training or placement conditions, start date, and role-specific H-1B policy before sharing documents or applying.

records.title: Management Consulting Analyst — New Graduate 2027
records.finding: The current employer page says the position has been filled. This corrects the earlier lead suggested in chat.
records.fit: The degree and 2027 graduation aligned with the original role. No application should be prepared for a filled position.
records.next: Check future Hatch business and advisory openings individually.

records.title: Environment, People, and Place Analyst
records.sponsorship: Employer states no employment visa sponsorship
records.finding: The employer explicitly excludes visa sponsorship for this role. Preferred studies also center on environmental and planning disciplines.
records.fit: Some analytical overlap, but sponsorship does not meet the requirement.
records.next: Do not apply under the current sponsorship requirement.

records.title: Global Operations Analyst Program — 2027
records.sponsorship: No current or future visa sponsorship
records.finding: Business Management and the graduation window fit, but the program excludes applicants needing current or future sponsorship. Its listed October 15, 2026 deadline has also passed.
records.fit: Operations and account-support experience align; eligibility prevents proceeding.
records.next: Do not apply to this program. Review other bank roles on their own terms.

records.title: U.S. Associate recruiting — 2027
records.sponsorship: Not evaluated for a specific opening
records.finding: The official recruiting page states that 2027 full-time and summer application windows have closed.
records.fit: Undergraduates from varied fields can enter this recruiting route, but the checked cycle is no longer accepting applications.
records.next: Look for separately advertised openings and future recruiting windows.

records.title: Financial Analyst Intern — Summer 2027
records.finding: Reading the full posting resolves the misleading search snippet: sponsorship is not available. This is an internship, not a full-time graduate role.
records.fit: Excel and business studies overlap, but it does not meet the sponsorship target.
records.next: Do not treat this as a sponsorship lead.

records.title: Entry Level Business Analyst — Project Management
records.sponsorship: H-1B mentioned in an old listing
records.finding: The posting specifies a September 2015 start date. Its sponsorship language does not establish a current vacancy or policy.
records.fit: Communication and business studies overlap; SQL and formal project methods need assessment. Age of the posting prevents treating it as a live lead.
records.next: Exclude this listing unless a current employer posting independently verifies the opportunity.
